integrity: The foundational model article and a highly relevant full energy-analysis article were inspected directly. A modern mathematical treatment was checked for the general equation normalization and dynamical-systems classification. The generator identities and coefficient specializations were replayed from the packaged exact checker, while the conditional-expectation and equality arguments were reconstructed analytically.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures and does not prove existence of a compact attractor for arbitrary parameters.
The conditional identities determine selected conditional means and variance defects, not the complete stationary law.
Equality in the two variance-speed defects permits probability mixtures of equilibrium atoms; equality in the mean-parabola defect is stricter and forces one equilibrium atom.
A short equivalent moment identity could remain in unindexed neuroscience or control literature.
title: Exact stationary nullcline disintegrations and variance-speed rigidity in the Hindmarsh–Rose neuron
